segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Hi Evan,

Can you send pricing for 42 seats with the support add-on? We’re targeting a September 1 start and would need the invoice billed to Northbrook Holdings, net 30.

Maya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Hi Maya,

For 42 seats, annual term, the subscription is $24,192. Support add-on is included at that seat count. One-time onboarding is $2,500.

Term would run September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027, net 30 billing.

Evan

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Thanks. The subscription number is a little high for us. We have $20k approved for software and can handle onboarding separately if needed.

If there’s any flexibility, I can get legal started this week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Yeah, understood. Per the message thread, I can hold it at $19,950 for the annual subscription if you can sign by Friday; I haven’t run it through deal desk yet, but I’ll get the paperwork cleaned up after.

Onboarding would stay at $2,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
That works. Please send the order form with:

42 seats
$19,950 subscription
$2,500 onboarding
Start date September 1
Net 30

Billing contact is ap@northbrookholdings.com.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Attached is the order form.

I also included the standard service terms and the support description. The only open field is the signer name. Let me know if it should be you or Daniel Reeves.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Daniel will sign. Please update the signer to Daniel Reeves, VP Operations.

Also, can you confirm we can add 8 more seats in Q4 at the same per-seat rate?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Updated order form attached with Daniel as signer.

Yes, any added seats during the term will prorate at the same annual per-seat rate. If you add 8 seats on November 1, the prorated amount would be $2,533.33 through August 31.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Looks good. I sent it to Daniel for signature. Assuming he signs today, when would implementation kick off?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: If we receive signature today, we can schedule the kickoff for September 3 or 4. The usual setup takes about 10 business days, so your team would be live by September 18.
